notebooks.execution_method: Executed all 22 code cells sequentially from an empty in-process IPython namespace with scripts/execute_notebook_inprocess.py. The final clean validation run completed in 12.1 seconds, retained all result-bearing outputs, generated five inline PNG figures, preserved coherent realization identity through every handoff, ran representative NeqSim well and native TwoFluidPipe calculations, completed hydrate, choke and MPFM screens, exported a SHA-256 manifest and ZIP handoff package, and stored zero errors or stderr. The normal Colab path clones, resolves and source-builds current NeqSim master. The controlled validation path used the pinned NeqSim 3.17.0 release JAR while recording the resolved current-master source commit. Retained PNGs were palette-optimized without changing dimensions or numerical data.

known_limitations: The stored ensemble, fluid, geometry and design criteria are synthetic teaching inputs; replace them with governed project data for engineering work.
A fixed 70 degC wellhead temperature is an explicit screening boundary while the representative well calculation focuses on pressure drop.
TwoFluidPipe supplies native hydraulic profiles; the stored thermal profile is a transparent steady U-value screen using NeqSim mixture heat capacity.
The internal Beggs-and-Brill comparison is not OLGA validation, and steady hydrate margins do not certify shutdown or restart operability.
Dominant SLUG classification and high liquid holdup are screening flags that require calibrated geometry and transient verification before design decisions.
